diagram_math_checks.result: Upper arrow adds bottom site 4 and the new rightmost top endpoint joined vertically. It sends the displayed W_{3,1} basis state to U because site 4 is a defect. Deleting that strand reverses the operation. This is exactly step 1.1; step 2.1 proves the module intertwining.

Lower source is a coset representative outside U, since site 4 is paired to 3. Cutting (3,4), deleting site 4, and making 3 a top-connected defect gives the all-defect W_{3,3} state. Its rightmost defect is 3; attaching new site 4 restores the original arc. No loop or scalar factor appears.
